title: fix(mobile): prevent SurfaceLayer crashing on maps in Viewer on Android
body:
Fixes #30495, #31087

Flutter has a longstanding issue (https://github.com/flutter/flutter/issues/118384) of not properly disposing platform views in some situations. MapLibre was rendering as a platform view in every asset viewer page, regardless of whether or not it was onscreen. As the user swiped through images, more and more `SurfaceFlinger` layers were leaked, eventually causing a crash for some users, or simply slow performance for others.

Switch to directly rendering to a `TextureView`, and don't render the map unless we actually need to.

----

Tested a before and after of 50+ swipes (both with asset info hidden and shown) on assets with and without location EXIF data. Recorded `dumpsys SurfaceFlinger --list` throughout, counting the leaks:
- Android 15 device (One Plus 9)
- Android 8 emulator (oldest supported version)
- Android 16 emulator (newest supported version)

The flag is inert on iOS, but iOS was also briefly checked to ensure the info display and swiping continues to work.
